title: 第11章 我不喜欢你现在未来都不会喜欢第12章 脚踏六条船翻船了
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
一个是积分任务奖励界面，主要用于看任务和积分奖励明细。
一个是积分商城，需要50点积分才能开启。
还有一个是星座庇护所。
因为星座庇护所一旦开启，无论是否使用满24小时，离开庇护所后都会触发冷却机制。
所以昭杺柠即使没有遇见危险，也连进庇护所看一眼都不敢。
就怕浪费了庇护所的进入时间，真正遇见危险的时候反而用不了了。
“你这个积分商城我倒是好奇，可惜还差些积分啊。”昭杺柠叹息。
话音刚落，就听见程序的奖励播报声。
【恭喜宿主，完成‘揭发魔尊百里魇伪装乞丐，意图潜入问天宗’阶段1任务，奖励10点积分】
【恭喜宿主，完成‘阻止魔族卧底仙门的任务已在星灵大陆广泛传播，吸引高热度魔族仇恨值’支线任务，奖励10点积分】
【宿主当前积分：41点】
“还差9点才能开启商城啊。”昭杺柠摸着肚子说：“或许商城有食物兑换。”
可问题是，她现在还差9点积分。
想着想着，昭杺柠抬头，目光跟坐在窗边的钟离珟眼神对视。
一巴掌等于一点积分。
九点积分等于九巴掌。
难道……真要她现在去扇钟离珟九巴掌吗？
想到这个，昭杺柠手心开始发热发痒，眸色更是跃跃欲试。
“休息好了？”屋内的钟离珟收好剑走来，扬眉询问昭杺柠。
在距离昭杺柠还有一米的位置时，钟离珟更是莫名停了脚步。

虽然不知道自己一个八星实力的强者，为什么不敢距离昭杺柠太近。
但钟离珟相信自己的直觉。
同样他也相信昭杺柠对扇他巴掌的执着。
“你退两步的动作是认真的吗？”这一次昭杺柠注意到钟离珟的小动作了，她满心狐疑：“我怎么感觉你有点怕我？”
“感觉错了。”钟离珟冷呵，大胆靠近昭杺柠，见她的手正捂着肚子，扬了扬眉笑问：“饿了？”
昭杺柠赏了他一个白眼。
又听见钟离珟在旁笑得欠兮兮地询问：“是不是还有点渴？”
“废话。”昭杺柠无语呵斥，说着就要抬手。
早有准备的钟离珟，一手接住她准备扇来的巴掌，笑道：“我可以送你去问膳堂，但我有个条件。”
“这个条件，也算是满足你一开始的要求。”
“我一开始的要求？”昭杺柠有点迷糊，她怎么不记得她一开始有什么要求了？
“在测试天赋台，你不是要跟我退婚吗。”钟离珟笑答：“只要你现在同意跟我退婚，我就送你去问膳堂吃饭，并且给你星石送你离开这里，去新的地方生活。”
听完钟离珟的条件，昭杺柠抓重点永远奇怪，真诚询问：“星石是什么？”
“星石就是星灵大陆的货币，也可用于吸收星石中的星辰力修炼。”钟离珟无力解释。
content_en:
One is the points task reward interface, which is mainly used to view tasks and point reward details.
One is the points mall, which requires 50 points to open.
Another one is Constellation Sanctuary.
Because once the constellation shelter is opened, no matter whether it is used for 24 hours or not, the cooling mechanism will be triggered after leaving the shelter.
Therefore, even if Zhao Hao Ning was not in danger, he would not even dare to enter the shelter to take a look.
I'm afraid that if I waste the time to enter the shelter, I won't be able to use it when I actually encounter danger.
"I'm curious about your points mall, but it's a pity that it's still short of points." Zhao Hao Ning sighed.
As soon as he finished speaking, he heard the program's reward announcement.
[Congratulations to the host for completing the Phase 1 mission of ‘Exposing Demon Lord Baili Xiang disguised as a beggar with the intention of sneaking into Wentian Sect’, and you will be rewarded with 10 points]
[Congratulations to the host, for completing the side mission of ‘stopping the undercover demons from the Immortal Sect, which has been widely spread in the Protoss Continent and attracting high-heat demon hatred’, you will be rewarded with 10 points]
[Host’s current points: 41 points]
"It's still 9 o'clock before the mall opens." Zhao Hao Ning touched her belly and said, "Maybe there is food exchange in the mall."
But the problem is, she is still 9 points short.
After thinking about it, Zhao Hao Ning raised his head and looked at Zhong Lizui who was sitting by the window.
A slap equals one point.
Nine points equals nine slaps.
Does...do you really want her to slap Zhongli Jujiu now?
Thinking of this, Zhao Hao Ning's palms began to feel hot and itchy, and his eyes became even more excited.
"Have you rested?" Zhongli Sui put away his sword and came over, raising his eyebrows and asking Zhao Hao Ning.
When he was still one meter away from Zhao Hao Ning, Zhong Lizui stopped inexplicably.
Although I don’t know why I, an eight-star strong person, dare not get too close to Zhao Hao Ning.
But Zhonglisuo trusted his intuition.
He also believed in Zhao Haining's persistence in slapping him.
"Are you serious about taking two steps back?" This time Zhao Hao Ning noticed Zhong Lizui's little move, and she was full of suspicion: "Why do I feel that you are a little afraid of me?"
"I feel wrong." Zhongli Sui said coldly and boldly approached Zhao Hao Ning. When he saw her hand covering her stomach, he raised his eyebrows and asked with a smile: "Are you hungry?"
Zhao Hao Ning gave him a roll of eyes.
Then I heard Zhong Lizuo laughing and asking, "Are you still a little thirsty?"
"Nonsense." Zhao Hao Ning scolded silently, raising her hand as she spoke.
Zhong Lizui, who was well prepared, caught the slap she was about to slap with one hand, and said with a smile, "I can send you to the Wenshan Hall, but I have a condition."
"This condition can be regarded as meeting your initial requirements."
"What was my initial request?" Zhao Hao Ning was a little confused. Why didn't she remember what she had asked for at the beginning?
"Aren't you going to break off the engagement with me at the talent testing platform?" Zhong Lizou smiled and replied: "As long as you agree to break off the engagement with me now, I will send you to the Wenshantang to eat, and I will give you a star stone to send you away from here and live in a new place."
After hearing Zhong Lizui's conditions, Zhao Hao Ning was always curious about the key points and asked sincerely: "What is the Star Stone?"
"Star stones are the currency of the Star Spirit Continent, and they can also be used to absorb the star power in the star stones for cultivation." Zhong Lizui was unable to explain.
